## Codex runtime mapping

Keep the canonical TSV and bundled `scripts/log.sh`. Write only inside the authorized workspace or task scratch path, verify evidence links, and use the native task history/rollout for transcript audit. Independent review follows the standing model router and is reported only when performed.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result). Local by default; commit it when a reviewer needs the trail to trust the result. Use for /show-me-your-work, autonomous or multi-phase runs, or work a human reviews after stepping away.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic build are static provenance only. Contextual security findings, active/reference classification, effects, credentials, and hold decisions are recorded in codex_contract.
reason: Preserve auditable decision trail while replacing Cursor transcript location and reviewer model defaults with native Codex paths and policy.

replacements.before: Read this run's transcript under the active workspace's `agent-transcripts/` directory (the system prompt names the path). Don't glob across `~/.cursor/projects/*/`. That reads unrelated private chats.
replacements.after: Read the current Codex task history through the native thread reader or its verified local rollout path when available. Do not glob other projects or rely on a Cursor transcript path; if full tool history is inaccessible, name that audit limit.

replacements.before: Before handing back, spawn a subagent on a different model family from the one that did the work. Self-review is not a substitute.
replacements.after: Before handing back, use an authorized independent Codex reviewer when a different model perspective is available under the standing `model-capability-router` policy. If no reviewer or full transcript access is available, report the evidence limit without inventing cross-model sign-off.

replacements.before: Lead with the reviewer's model on its own line (`reviewed by <model>`), then list each flag pointing to specific rows or moments. "No flags" is a valid value. The model name is not.
replacements.after: Name the actual reviewer model when one ran, then list flags tied to rows or moments. If review could not run, label it not assessed; never infer a reviewer from the selected route.
